sunoData.title: Hollow Trail
sunoData.tags: Ambient game soundtrack with slow evolving drones and a faint off-kilter pulse, built for abandoned spaces and uncanny stillness; verse-like sections drift on brittle texture beds, a middle layer brings bowed metal swells and distant reversed chimes, then a later swell adds low sub rumbles and spectral noise blooms. Ghostly ear candy includes warped room-tone passes, creaking wood crests, and filtered risers into each transition. Mix is wide, dark, and cinematic with intimate decay in the details., ambient
